description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 09.10.2017 to 15.10.2017
reasoning: This gazette notification pertains to the establishment of new rates of exchange for customs duties and charges, as determined by the Director General of Customs under the authority of the Customs Ordinance. It is a regulatory matter concerning the legal framework for calculating import/export duties, falling squarely under the "Legal/Regulatory Gazettes" category (Type 5) for statutory instruments and regulatory requirements.
